438:t_011:0.en:
$$タケル$$
「...I'll dive into $n's mind once more.」

438:t_011:2.en:
$$シャア$$
「The darkness inside $n runs deep. If you're careless, you won't make it back either.」

438:t_011:3.en:
$$タケル$$
「I might not be able to do it with my strength alone... But if we combine the strength of everyone here...!」

438:t_011:4.en:
$$刹那$$
「Understood, $$タケル$$. We'll connect everyone's hearts.」

438:t_011:5.en:
$$アムロ$$
「You understand, $$カミーユ$$, $$バナージ$$! It's the same as during the $$時空修復$$!」

438:t_011:7.en:
$$バナージ$$
「If we make the $$ユニコーン$$'s $$サイコ・フレーム$$ resonate with the GN particles...!」

438:t_011:8.en:
$$ティファ$$
「$$タケル$$... Please take my power.」

438:t_011:10.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「What do you intend to do, $$マーズ$$!?」

438:t_011:11.en:
$$タケル$$
「$$ゲシュタルト$$... no, $$ズール$$! I am not afraid of the darkness!!」

438:t_012:2.en:
$$タケル$$
「I'll dive into $n's mind and wake him up!」

438:t_012:3.en:
$$シン$$
「Can you really do something like that!?」

438:t_012:4.en:
$$タケル$$
「I don't know... But in the $$時獄戦役$$, I was able to reach the depths of $$グーラ$$'s heart.」

438:t_012:5.en:
$$タケル$$
「If I can get that sensation from back then once more...!」

438:t_012:7.en:
$$シャア$$
「The darkness inside $n runs deep. If you're careless, you won't make it back either.」

438:t_012:8.en:
$$タケル$$
「I might not be able to do it with my strength alone... But if we combine the strength of everyone here...!」

438:t_012:9.en:
$$刹那$$
「Understood, $$タケル$$. We'll connect everyone's hearts.」

438:t_012:10.en:
$$アムロ$$
「You understand, $$カミーユ$$, $$バナージ$$! It's the same as during the $$時空修復$$!」

438:t_012:12.en:
$$バナージ$$
「If we make the $$ユニコーン$$'s $$サイコ・フレーム$$ resonate with the GN particles...!」

438:t_012:13.en:
$$ティファ$$
「$$タケル$$... Please take my power.」

438:t_012:15.en:
$$タケル$$
「$$ゲシュタルト$$... no, $$ズール$$! I am not afraid of the darkness!!」

438:t_013:2.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The hope I conveyed... Turning it into power is up to you yourself.」

438:t_014:2.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Impossible! Are you saying it's $$スズネ$$'s power!?」

438:t_015:0.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What the $$いがみ合う双子$$ needs for its true activation is to make conflicting emotions coexist, and then go beyond them...」

438:t_015:1.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Go beyond conflicting emotions, you say...!?」

438:t_015:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I have incorporated the $$ガナリー・カーバー$$ data into the $$ジェニオン$$.」

438:t_015:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「With that, the $$ジェニオン$$ will answer $n's feelings and change its form.」

438:t_015:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Furthermore, I received from $$トライア$$ the data for a system that converts a $$スフィア$$ directly into weaponry, and...」

438:t_015:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And I have granted it part of the autonomy the $$ガンレオン$$ possesses.」

438:t_015:8.en:
$$ランド$$
「So what does that mean, exactly!?」

438:t_015:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The $$ジェニオン$$ will soon be reborn.」

438:t_015:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「A form that answers $n's will and its own, turning the power of the $$いがみ合う双子$$ $$スフィア$$ into power for more direct combat...」

438:t_015:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「In other words, the $$ジェニオン$$'s completed form... the $$ジェミニオン$$...!」

438:t_016:0.en:
$$アムロ$$
「So that's the $$ジェミニオン$$...!」

438:t_016:1.en:
$$シャア$$
「What is that... that ominous aura!」

438:t_016:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Truly a Diabolus Ex Machina... The birth of the most malevolent machine god, one that fears not even the gods.」

438:t_017:1.en:
$$セツコ$$
「The $$スフィア$$'s glow won't stop...」

438:t_017:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「This is bad! Isn't it going berserk!?」

438:t_017:4.en:
$n
「Not clinging to convenient hopes, and not going reckless in despair, but doing what I'm supposed to do...」

438:t_017:5.en:
$n
「Right now, I'm going beyond hope and despair!!」

438:t_018:1.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Tch! This is bad!!」

438:t_020:0.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Wrong...! That... isn't the $$ジェミニオン$$!」

438:t_020:1.en:
$n
「What's wrong, $$ＡＧ$$? Are you rattled because I'm not moving the way you wanted?」

438:t_020:3.en:
$n
「You said it yourself. That in response to my will and this guy's, the $$ジェニオン$$ would transform.」

438:t_020:4.en:
$n
「Even the pilot suit changed. Talk about full service.」

438:t_020:6.en:
$n
「Don't call it by some name of your own! This is my power to fight... I'm the one who names it!」

438:t_020:7.en:
$n
「This guy's name is $$ジェミニオン・レイ$$...! Going beyond everything, I make this place a new beginning!」

438:t_020:9.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「...$$ジェミニオン・レイ$$... Not bad.」

438:t_020:10.en:
$n
「Come, $$アムブリエル$$. I don't think for a second that you'd go down to that much.」

438:t_020:11.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「You know me well, $n!」

438:t_021:0.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「$$ジェミニオン・レイ$$...! Now I want it even more!」

438:t_021:2.en:
$$甲児$$
「Stop her and save Miss $$スズネ$$!」

438:t_021:3.en:
$n
「You all gave me strength...! I won't let it go to waste!」
